test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

Every morning a shrill noise wake me up.
solution: The correct answer is 'wake me up'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, 'wakes me up' should be used instead of 'wake me up'. • We know that after **'each, every, everyone, someone, nobody, one' a singular verb, singular noun, singular adjective, and a singular pronoun** is used. • *Example: **Each** student **has** come.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.** **Correct Sentence:__** *Every morning a shrill noise wakes me up.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां **'wake me up'** की जगह** 'wakes me up'** का इस्तेमाल करना चाहिए। • हम जानते हैं कि** 'every, each, everyone, someone, nobody, one' के बाद singular verb, singular noun, singular adjective** और **singular pronoun** का प्रयोग किया जाता है। • *Example: Each student **has** come.* • अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प** 1 **है। 35:Tba7, The correct answer is '**Disperse**'.
